note: What a community's values suggest for its decision-making processes. Recommendations are context-neutral — they do not presuppose whether a decision is routine or structural; that is for the community to determine. Up to 5 recommendations per value. All items need_review before use. strength: how strongly the value argues for (+1, +2) or against (−1, −2) the option; it adds to or takes from the option's score in suggestions (js/recommend.js). Only status "accepted" is used (proposed ones are previewed while in review).
